items.problem: `gameIssues` reads the core release with `coreFiles` → `coreRelease` (tools/src/commands/settings/lib/core-files.ts:51), not `coreReleaseOfGame`, so `ogw game check` and `ogw settings set game` on a game whose `coreVersion` is newer than the harness core or below `minCoreVersion` pass without the failure that AGENTS.md `## repo` sets for every command on a game

`ogw loop record` crashes on a play that has no result file. `launchPlay` (tools/src/commands/loop/lib/evaluate.ts:416) writes the play entry `{"result": "", "status": "failed"}` when the save fixture of a judge moment does not start, which `## loop evaluate` of tools/ogw.md allows and tools/test/commands/loop/evaluate.test.ts:347 asserts. `playsOf` then calls `readGameText(game, "")`, whose path is the game repo root, so `exists` is true and `readFile` throws `EISDIR`. Reproduced in a temporary copy: `iterationOne()` of tools/test/commands/loop/record.test.ts plus that play entry makes `ogw loop findings` pass and `ogw loop record` exit 1 with `EISDIR: illegal operation on a directory`. No iteration record is written, so `ogw loop verdict` also refuses and the iteration cannot end. A moment whose fixture is missing at the work branch HEAD (e.g. an unwritten `memorable_moment.json`) is enough to reach it. Both lines are the same at the start of the range
